caseNameFull: United States v. Alabama United States v. Mississippi and United States v. Louisiana
attorneys: Attorney General Katzenbach, Solicitor General Marshall, Assistant Attorney General Doar, Ralph S. Spritzer and Louis F. Claiborne on the motions.

opinions.text: The motions to expedite consideration are granted and the defendants are directed to file responses to the motions for leave to file bills of complaint on or before November 10, 1965.
